svg.title: MeetPulse Desktop — architecture
svg.desc: How MeetPulse Desktop is built: a Tauri 2 app with a Next.js interface, a Rust core, local SQLite and llama.cpp, and an optional cloud gateway.

g.data-desc: Runs inside Tauri's WebView. It never touches audio or models; it only talks to the core.
Mixes microphone and system audio and lets only speech through.
Child process that runs the local models, driven through stdin/stdout.
Meetings, transcripts, chats and vector indexes, in a file on your machine.
